description: Quick guide to development commands that you can send to the terminal in one click
config.confirmDestructive: Ask for confirmation before writing to the terminal or copying a destructive command (for example `git reset --hard` or `rm -rf`).
config.detectProject: Show the categories of the open project first, in an "In this project" section. Only checks whether these files or folders exist in the root of each workspace folder: `.git`, `package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `package-lock.json`, `Dockerfile`, `compose.yaml`/`compose.yml`, `docker-compose.yml`/`docker-compose.yaml`.
config.customCommands: Your own command categories, shown after the built-in ones. Each category has `id`, `title`, optional `icon` (a Codicon) and `commands`. Each command has `id`, `title` and `command` (the bash template, with `${name}` placeholders declared in `params`), and optionally `description`, `params`, `risk` (`safe`, `caution` or `destructive`), `shells` (variants for `bash`, `zsh`, `powershell` or `cmd`) and `tags`. Texts can be a string or an object per language (`{ "en": "…", "es": "…" }`). Run **DevCommands: Edit Custom Commands** to start from an example. Invalid entries are skipped and listed in the DevCommands log.
